'''Sarlin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Sarlin resided in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]]. While there, he received a contraband shipment from a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] working for [[Barak]].

==Behind the scenes==
Sarlin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Sarlin was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Smuggler#Underworld Smuggler Missions|smuggling missions]] introduced with the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 3|"Chapter 3" update]], released on [[September 27]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>

In the game, Barak tasked smugglers with delivering contraband to various NPCs, including Sarlin.
